_help: Meme Coin Launch Kit. Names come from the visitor's theme words dropped into namePatterns ({W} = a theme word, {W2} = a second one). Tickers are made from the name. Text templates use {name}, {ticker}, {theme} and {word}. Keep all copy free of price or return promises (a test checks for banned words). pumpFields lists what the pump.fun create form asked for when this was written: check it against the site.

the official {ticker} account · {theme} memes daily · no promises, just fun
